data.description:
# ❄️☃️Winter Update! 

- New **Slide Surfer Gimmick** | Make ice slides and fly in the air! 
- Winter Battle Pass and a brand new Holiday Bundle!
- Lobby & Bongos have a new Winter theme

=================================================

![{"height":400,"type":"image","width":1280}](https://scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39035456_8710703839039801_7581387380512021967_n.png?_nc_cat=108&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=T-fc43LwjLkQ7kNvgGZ25zM&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAY56thIbpHLIDwn7TaU0ZxpFujRVnre8u4FLzcR6_lYw&oe=67595A3B)
**About**
# Live in the heart of the Bermuda Triangle with all your Monkey friends! Swing on vines, throw doo at your enemies, and climb everything! 

- Huge Maps: Explore the Bermuda Jungle, Floating Forests, Ancient Ruins, Lava Chasm, and more

- Unique Gamemodes: Be the first to collect 10 bananas or work together to fend off hordes of crocs -- new modes are coming all the time

- Monkey Apparel: Customize your body color, equip face & head cosmetics, and stylize your doo

- Ruby Mines: Explore a seemingly endless set of tunnels filled with lore, new NPC's, and our Battle Pass! Unlock exclusive rewards like Cosmetics, Doos, Boosters, and more with free and paid rewards! 

{2327501694315626}

Themed Cosmetics & Hands-on Fun: Get your hands on... well, Hand cosmetics! Plus, a bunch of wacky, interactive items like things you can eat, press, and shake to your heart's content.

Hidden Treasures: Dive into a revamped store experience and hunt for secrets - like a mysterious portal leading to a hidden market. Plus, uncover new secrets via the plane!

Jump into the recently installed mining elevator to descend deep into the old ruby mines. Survive the **wrath of Xongo & save the Lost Souls** in Monkey Doo's all new Horror Mode!

{9314948115205875}
